descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team Pictet Asset Management manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions,financial intermediaries and their clients. Our culture welcomes independent thinkers and centres around investment excellence, a long-term perspective and a dedication to client service. The Investment Reporting team serves institutional clients and financial intermediaries through three core pillars: producing high‑quality client and marketing documents; promoting an exceptional client experience by providing customized and timely solutions; and innovating to continuously improve how documents are designed, produced and distributed. Your role Production of documents
• Deliver high‑quality investment reports, marketing materials and client presentations with a strong focus on accuracy, consistency and timeliness.
• Own end‑to‑end production topics: manage priorities with stakeholders,anticipate bottlenecks, and ensure reliable delivery during peak periods.
• Contribute to strengthening production robustness through ongoing process improvements.
• Play an integral role in the migration of existing reports to the Vermilion Reporting Suite (VRS) and the transition of our data to Snowflake. Client Experience Enhancement
• Improve client satisfaction by raising quality standards and service responsiveness.
• Evolve reports, templates and content to enhance investment insights, increase clarity, storytelling and visual impact for our clients.
• Partner with Sales and Investment teams for client meetings/reviews and translate feedback into concrete improvements in reporting output and service practices. Reporting Innovation
• Identify pragmatic opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate recurring tasks to improve efficiency and quality at scale by using technology. Your profile We’re looking for a proactive, motivated and skilled individual who brings analytical thinking, technical skills to support modern reporting, a client mindset, and a collaborative approach. The ideal candidate will have:
• A university degree in Finance, Mathematics, Economics , or a related field.
• A solid understanding of financial markets , with experience in investment reporting / client reporting or a similar environment with a strong focus on Fixed Income and Multi-Asset.
• Strong analytical problem-solving skills , high attention to detail , and a proven quality mindset.
• Comfortable working independently , taking ownership, and collaborating effectively across teams and locations.
• Ability to translate complex investment data into clear, visually compelling client-facing material.
• Advanced SQL, Excel and PowerPoint.
• Experience with VRS / Snowflake / Tableau is a strong asset.
• Strong interest in new technology and AI / GenAI, applied to automation, quality controls and innovation generation, Python highly valued. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Pictet Tech division specializes in designing and integrating cutting-edge software applications, including advanced portfolio management systems, sophisticated trading platforms, and comprehensive banking and corporate solutions. As a key contributor to the Group’s strategic advancements, the division plays a vital role in driving transformative innovations that enhance our services and deliver exceptional value to our clients. The Technical Business Analyst acts as a bridge between business stakeholders and development teams, supporting the Funds Platform with a particular focus on Transfer Agency (TA) processes. The role is responsible for understanding, analyzing, and translating business needs into effective technical solutions, ensuring the continuous improvement of business analysis practices and contributing to the overall success of the platform within the funds industry. Your role
• Collaborate with business subject matter experts and stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for the funds platform, with a particular focus on Transfer Agency (TA) processes and operations.
• Translate business needs into clear, actionable IT requirements, user stories, and test scenarios using Agile methodologies and Jira.
• Propose and evaluate solution options in coordination with solution architects, considering existing systems, software, and market innovations (including AI).
• Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation, including specifications, process flows, and user guides.
• Lead project management activities as necessary, including stakeholder coordination, meeting facilitation, and milestone tracking.
• Conduct data analysis and support data-driven decision-making.
• Ensure the execution and delivery of IT projects in line with business requirements, timelines, and quality standards.
• Carry out functional acceptance testing, analyze production incidents, and support users during and after implementation.
• Contribute to process improvement initiatives by designing and implementing efficient workflows during system changes or migrations, focusing on innovation and optimization over replication of legacy processes
• Actively participate as a member of the Business Analyst Chapter; s hare knowledge, best practices, and drive the evolution of the business analysis discipline within the chapter Your profile
• Min 5 years experience in a bank as Business Analyst
• Fluent in French and English
• Proven experience as a Business Analyst or Technical Business Analyst in the funds industry, with a strong focus on transfer agency processes.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; able to facilitate meetings and workshops.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a dynamic environment
• Project management experience, including organizing and leading cross-functional meetings.
• Fluent in English, French is an asset
• In-depth knowledge of transfer agency functions, including investor servicing, transaction processing, and related regulatory requirements.
• Experience with industry platforms and tools relevant to transfer agency (e.g., Multifonds TA, Fenergo); experience with system integrations and data migrations is a plus.
• Proficiency in SQL for data analysis and troubleshooting
• Experience working in Agile environments, with hands-on use of JIRA (and Confluence) for story management and project tracking.
• Ability to write clear, structured documentation and user stories.
• Familiarity with AI tools and their application in business analysis; experience implementing AI-driven solutions is a plus. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Pictet has been present in Singapore for more than 30 years where it employs over 200 people. The Compliance function is responsible for helping Pictet’s senior management manage the compliance risks faced by Pictet. This role will focus on the risks faced by Pictet’s Singapore bank, Banque Pictet & Cie SA (BPSA) Singapore Branch. The AML/CFT Compliance Officer is part of the team that oversees the Bank’s financial crime framework, focused primarily on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance. The incumbent performs systematic AML/CFT reviews on high-risk clients before onboarding and subsequent periodic reviews, reviews alerts/issues escalated by first-line functions and reports suspicions of criminal or sanctioned activity, and provides advice on AML/CFT and sanctions management. . The officer monitors changes that may impact the business, working with business and support functions to ensure that the Bank complies with regulatory obligations and Group standards in the financial crime area. The role will report to the Compliance AML Lead. Your role Key responsibilities -Investigate relevant alerts and suspicious activities, and perform filing of STR to local authorities. -Perform ex-ante AML reviews on high-risk client onboarding and periodic reviews. -Review escalated alerts from first-line transaction monitoring, payment filtering and ongoing name screening controls. -Support external requests include production orders, due diligence queries and any relevant regulatory reporting (e.g. Remote Gambling Act reporting). -Act as an expert advisor to business and support functions on compliance and regulatory matters related to AML/CFT and international sanctions management. -Perform an annual AML/CFT Enterprise-wide Risk Assessment (EWRA) identifying risks and framework/control gaps to the attention of management and Group -Compliance. -Assist with periodical risk-based design and operating effectiveness testing of first-line AML/CFT controls, including on lower-risk clients. -Represent Compliance as needed on financial crime related projects and initiatives. -Assist in the resolution of Compliance-owned management action plans from audits, inspections and Group reviews. -Produce relevant management information reports to board and senior management on the governance of financial crime risks. -Build and maintain a proactive and constructive relationship with business and functional stakeholders to ensure appropriate controls are in place for financial crime risk identification and management. -Keep abreast and understand the impact of new financial crime regulations and where needed, represent the Bank in industry consultations. -Support the Singapore AML Lead on all AML/CFT matters and any other duties as assigned. Your profile -Bachelor Degree in law, banking or business. -Working knowledge of the CDSA, AML/CFT typologies, relevant MAS Regulations and Guidance on AML/CFT and the international sanctions framework. -Working experience of Singapore regulatory landscape and expectations needed. Familiarity with regulations and guidance in an AML, Financial crime Compliance role. -6-10 years of relevant experience in AML/CFT compliance particularly on investigations. -Prior experience in a similar role in a Private Bank will be advantageous. -Highly effective verbal and written communication and organizational skills. -Ability to multi-task competing priorities while maintaining a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail. -Capable of working with cross-functional and senior stakeholders. -Sense of accountability, good time management and ability to meet tight deadlines. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

Your team The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people. Your role The Taiwan Intermediary sales team is currently made up of professionals who prospect and service intermediary clients throughout Taiwan by marketing Pictet Asset Management’s (Pictet AM) strategies. Reporting to the Head of Sales - Taiwan, you will play a critical role in Pictet AM’s drive to further develop its business in Taiwan. Your responsibilities will be:
• Foster strong collaborative relationships with distributors and financial advisors to boost sales activities.
• Address and assist distributors' headquarters and clients in resolving product and market-related inquiries while nurturing relationships.
• Organize seminars and meetings to facilitate engagement and knowledge sharing.
• Actively participate in fund sales initiatives and strive to partner with distributors in campaigns to achieve the company's business goals and increase brand awareness.
• Regularly visit branches for fund promotion and training.
• Gather, organize, analyse, and share market intelligence related to distributors and industry peers.
• Contribute to the development of effective sales strategies based on market insights.
• Proactively carry out tasks assigned by the sales head, ensuring efficient and accurate completion of various assignments.
• Maintain various documents, including updating client contact information, preparing call reports, and documenting activity notes in Salesforce (SF). Your profile
• Hold a university degree or higher, with a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in the financial industry.
• Have a deep understanding of various mutual fund products, such as equity, fixed-income, private equity and ETFs.
• Possess excellent interpersonal skills that foster effective teamwork and communication.
• Exhibit strong presentation skills to deliver persuasive sales pitches.
• Demonstrate problem-solving abilities and a strong sense of responsibility and commitment to the business. As the successful applicant you will show drive, have a keen entrepreneurial spirit and be able to develop successful business relationships and close deals. You will also have a flair for communication, be able to manage priorities and multi-task on different projects concurrently, as well as having an eye for detail. Working in a self-reliant manner in a broader team makes you excel. You will be joining a structured and highly motivated team. Your team Business Compliace Manager The successful candidate will join a team whose principal function is to analyse and perform control activities related to anti-money laundering (AML) and business risks. Your role The function will, amongst other tasks, assist the Chief Risk Officer & MLRO with:
• Promoting a strong compliance culture within the Bank.
• Reviewing new account applications for compliance with KYC requirements.
• Completing risk ratings of new accounts.
• Periodic reviews of existing customer accounts.
• Identification and review of unusual transactions.
• Review and analysis of name screening alerts.
• Reporting of key performamce indicators. Your profile
• Strong analytical skills.
• Ability to work independently and under pressure to meet strict deadlines.
• Must be a team player.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills.
• Excellent problem solving and organizational skills.
• Excellent research and analytical skills.
• Proficiency in a variety of software applications including Microsoft Office.
• At least five (5) years compliance or audit experience in a Private Bank or Trust Company.
• University degree (Banking, Finance, Law, Business Administration or a related field).
• Professional qualification (ICA International Compliance and Anti-Money Laundering Diplomas or ACAMS Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Certification).
• Experience in the preparation of information reports.
• In-depth knowledge of The Bank & Trust Companies Regulation Act, 2020. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. This function will join the Quality Control & Mobile team , reporting to the head of the team. In this role you will work on quality-control-related activities for the three teams (FA, TA and PETAL) and occasionally help the production teams during peak periods. Your role Mobile team
• Participate mainly for short support missions within the fund operational units to absorb operational overloads, identify process optimizations and support implementation of initiatives supporting operational efficiency.
• Identify areas of improvement in terms of the process and control framework, based on your experience in other teams and departments. The role of the function is to participate mainly for short support missions within the fund operational units to absorb operational overloads, identify process optimizations and support implementation of initiatives supporting operational efficiency. Quality Control
• Contribute to the implementation of key quality control deliverables such as KPIs developed with our BI platform (Tableau).
• Coordinate transversal reporting.
• Contribute to any other transversal project aimed at improving service delivery. Your profile Education:
• Master’s degree in Business administration or engineering (finance, IT, mathematics). Requested experience:
• 1 to 3 years’ experience in project management and change management, Process / data modelling, Fund operations or banking sector. Technical skills:
• Project Management skills.
• Data analysis and office tools skills (Excel, Tableau, PowerPoint, etc.). Soft skills:
• Organisational skills.
• Diligent in achieving objectives.
• Strong analytical and synthesis skills.
• Effective communication abilities and good interpersonal skills.
• Commitment-oriented mindset and a team spirit. Language skills:
• Fluent in French and English Note We will not accept any CVs from agencies. In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description. Flexible and modern ways of working As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave. Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. • Identify areas of improvement in terms of the process and control framework, based on your experience in other teams and departments. descriptionByLocale.it:
Sua squadra La divisione delle Funzioni Corporate comprende le attività non bancarie del Gruppo e comprende oltre 600 dipendenti. Staffata da specialisti con una profonda conoscenza in tutti i settori commerciali, le funzioni centrali sono poste in vari dipartimenti del Gruppo: Comunicazione, Compliance, Finanza, Risorse Umane, Sicurezza dell'Informazione, Revisione Interna, Legale, Ufficio Corporativo, Rischio e Tassazione. Il team di Gestione delle Istituzioni Finanziarie (FIM), parte del Dipartimento di Finanza, è il centro di competenza del Gruppo per la gestione delle relazioni con le istituzioni finanziarie. Come membro chiave di questo team, aiutate a mantenere e migliorare le relazioni del Gruppo con i nostri controparti. Il suo ruolo
• Stiamo cercando un professionista proattivo e analitico per assumere la proprietà dell'accettazione della gestione dei dati, della semplificazione dei flussi di lavoro e della promozione dell'automazione dei processi all'interno delle attività del team. Aiuterete a guidare la trasformazione e l'implementazione di queste iniziative per garantire un continuo miglioramento e innovazione. Le sue responsabilità saranno: Miglioramento dei processi e automazione - Analizzare e mappare i processi attuali, i sistemi e le strumentazioni all'interno delle attività del team. - Identificare inefficienze e prendere l'iniziativa per attaccare e implementare correttamente. - Assumere la proprietà delle soluzioni di automazione e guida la trasformazione digitale dei flussi di lavoro, sfruttando analisi avanzate e le ultime tecnologie. - Ridurre la dipendenza dai processi manuali e dalle richieste basate su email introducendo soluzioni robuste e scalabili. Gestione dei dati e qualità - Mantenere e migliorare i dati di poleparte finanziaria (codificazione, dati statici). - Guidare gli sforzi per costruire e gestire una "fonte d'oro" centralizzata dei dati, garantendo alta qualità e coerenza dei dati. - Implementare e monitorare controlli di qualità dei dati automatizzati, garantendo la conservazione e la coerenza dei dati all'interno dei sistemi. Reporting e monitoraggio - Preparare dashboard e rapporti di impatto per i interni team e la direzione senior, utilizzando strumenti di visualizzazione dei dati di ultima generazione. - Partecipare a progetti che influenzano le attività del team, guidando l'innovazione, l'efficienza e l'adozione di nuove metodologie di scienza dei dati. Il suo profilo - Laurea magistrale o equivalente. - 3 a 5 anni di esperienza e interesse per il settore bancario, o precedente esperienza nell'industria bancaria. - Esperienza in KYC/AML sarebbe un plus. - Forte mindset analitico e risolutorio. - Proattivo, orientato alla soluzione e in grado di prendere l'iniziativa, strutturato, con forte attenzione ai. - Comitato, orientale ai risultati e responsabile. - Forte spirito di squadra con la capacità di collaborare con le squadre e le linee di business. - Interesse per il miglioramento dei processi, l'automazione e la visualizzazione dei dati, sfruttando la tecnologia. - Esperienza in SQL e Python. - Esperienza con gli strumenti di Business Intelligence (Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau) e nella implementazione di progetti Gen AI. - Familiarità con i concetti di gestione dei dati (qualità/governance). - Fluenza in francese e inglese; altre lingue sono un plus. - Deve essere residente in Svizzera. Nota Non accetteremo alcun CV tramite agenzie. Diversità e inclusione Pictet è un datore di lavoro che offre pari opportunità e si impegna a creare un ambiente diverso. Riaspetta tutte le persone e trucchi la loro inclusione nel posto di lavoro. Candidatura Salva il lavoro Invia un'email a un contatto Torna alla lista
descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team The Corporate Functions division encompasses the Group’s non-banking activities and comprises over 600 employees. Staffed by specialists with deep expertise across all business lines, the central functions are organised into various group departments: Communication, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Corporate Office, Risk and Taxation. The Financial Institutions Management (FIM) team, part of the Finance Department, is the Group's centre of expertise for managing relationships with financial institutions. As a key member of this team, you will help maintain and enhance the Group's vital relationships with our financial counterparties. Your role We are seeking a proactive and analytical professional to take ownership of optimising data management, streamlining workflows, and driving process automation across the team's activities. You will lead the transformation and implementation of these initiatives to ensure continuous improvement and innovation. You will be responsible for the following tasks: Process improvement and automation
• Analyse and map current processes, systems and tools across the team's activities.
• Identify inefficiencies and take the initiative to propose and implement improvements.
• Take ownership of automation solutions and drive the digital transformation of our workflows, leveraging advanced analytics and the latest technologies.
• Reduce reliance on manual processes and email-based requests by introducing robust, scalable solutions. Data Management and Quality
• Maintain and enhance financial counterparty master data (codification, static data).
• Lead efforts to build and manage a centralised “golden source” of data, ensuring high data quality and consistency.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Pictet has been present in Singapore for more than 30 years where it employs over 200 people. The Compliance function is responsible for helping Pictet’s senior management manage the compliance risks faced by Pictet. This role will focus on the risks faced by Pictet’s Singapore bank, Banque Pictet & Cie SA (BPSA) Singapore Branch. The AML/CFT Compliance Officer is part of the team that oversees the Bank’s financial crime framework, focused primarily on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance. The incumbent performs systematic AML/CFT reviews on high-risk clients before onboarding and subsequent periodic reviews, reviews alerts/issues escalated by first-line functions and reports suspicions of criminal or sanctioned activity, and provides advice on AML/CFT and sanctions management. . The officer monitors changes that may impact the business, working with business and support functions to ensure that the Bank complies with regulatory obligations and Group standards in the financial crime area. The role will report to the Compliance AML Lead. Your role Key responsibilities -Investigate relevant alerts and suspicious activities, and perform filing of STR to local authorities. -Perform ex-ante AML reviews on high-risk client onboarding and periodic reviews. -Review escalated alerts from first-line transaction monitoring, payment filtering and ongoing name screening controls. -Support external requests include production orders, due diligence queries and any relevant regulatory reporting (e.g. Remote Gambling Act reporting). -Act as an expert advisor to business and support functions on compliance and regulatory matters related to AML/CFT and international sanctions management. -Perform an annual AML/CFT Enterprise-wide Risk Assessment (EWRA) identifying risks and framework/control gaps to the attention of management and Group -Compliance. -Assist with periodical risk-based design and operating effectiveness testing of first-line AML/CFT controls, including on lower-risk clients. -Represent Compliance as needed on financial crime related projects and initiatives. -Assist in the resolution of Compliance-owned management action plans from audits, inspections and Group reviews. -Produce relevant management information reports to board and senior management on the governance of financial crime risks. -Build and maintain a proactive and constructive relationship with business and functional stakeholders to ensure appropriate controls are in place for financial crime risk identification and management. -Keep abreast and understand the impact of new financial crime regulations and where needed, represent the Bank in industry consultations. -Support the Singapore AML Lead on all AML/CFT matters and any other duties as assigned. Your profile -Bachelor Degree in law, banking or business. -Working knowledge of the CDSA, AML/CFT typologies, relevant MAS Regulations and Guidance on AML/CFT and the international sanctions framework. -Working experience of Singapore regulatory landscape and expectations needed. Familiarity with regulations and guidance in an AML, Financial crime Compliance role. -6-10 years of relevant experience in AML/CFT compliance particularly on investigations. -Prior experience in a similar role in a Private Bank will be advantageous. -Highly effective verbal and written communication and organizational skills. -Ability to multi-task competing priorities while maintaining a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail. -Capable of working with cross-functional and senior stakeholders. -Sense of accountability, good time management and ability to meet tight deadlines. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

Your team The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people. Your role The Taiwan Intermediary sales team is currently made up of professionals who prospect and service intermediary clients throughout Taiwan by marketing Pictet Asset Management’s (Pictet AM) strategies. Reporting to the Head of Sales - Taiwan, you will play a critical role in Pictet AM’s drive to further develop its business in Taiwan. Your responsibilities will be:
• Foster strong collaborative relationships with distributors and financial advisors to boost sales activities.
• Address and assist distributors' headquarters and clients in resolving product and market-related inquiries while nurturing relationships.
• Organize seminars and meetings to facilitate engagement and knowledge sharing.
• Actively participate in fund sales initiatives and strive to partner with distributors in campaigns to achieve the company's business goals and increase brand awareness.
• Regularly visit branches for fund promotion and training.
• Gather, organize, analyse, and share market intelligence related to distributors and industry peers.
• Contribute to the development of effective sales strategies based on market insights.
• Proactively carry out tasks assigned by the sales head, ensuring efficient and accurate completion of various assignments.
• Maintain various documents, including updating client contact information, preparing call reports, and documenting activity notes in Salesforce (SF). Your profile
• Hold a university degree or higher, with a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in the financial industry.
• Have a deep understanding of various mutual fund products, such as equity, fixed-income, private equity and ETFs.
• Possess excellent interpersonal skills that foster effective teamwork and communication.
• Exhibit strong presentation skills to deliver persuasive sales pitches.
• Demonstrate problem-solving abilities and a strong sense of responsibility and commitment to the business. As the successful applicant you will show drive, have a keen entrepreneurial spirit and be able to develop successful business relationships and close deals. You will also have a flair for communication, be able to manage priorities and multi-task on different projects concurrently, as well as having an eye for detail. Working in a self-reliant manner in a broader team makes you excel. You will be joining a structured and highly motivated team. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. The Role is to provide 1st level support on Fund Admnistration activities. To centralise, coordinate, and respond to Clients, Business Lines & Auditors requests and contribute to improvements of the processes, procedures and operational platforms to guarantee the proper application of controls and consistently exceed client’s needs and expectations. Your role
• Collaborate with Business Implementation Team, Client Relationship Managers (CRM), Management Companies and other key stakeholders (Custody Bank, Pricing, Transfer Agent (TA)…) on Projects & fund-related events.
• Act as the main liaison for both external and internal Clients, as well as Auditors, regarding all Fund Administration day-to-day activities.
• Manage the end-to-end Audit process for the funds, from initial planning & timetable, preparation and coordination of the financial statements to final approval and CSSF filling. Respond to Audit queries and ensure timely implementation of corrective actions and / or process improvement & automation as needed.
• Support Fund Administration Operations teams and effectively manage relationships across various business lines, including CRM, Business Implementation Team, TA , Tax, and others.
• Demonstrate a proactive mindset in addressing fund-related issues, actively challenge the status quo, and contribute innovative ideas for process enhancement.
• Participate in due diligence meetings, service reviews, Client visits, and Board meetings as required.
• Monitor internal and external KPIs and take actions when needed
• Manage and resolve internal and external escalations, taking appropriate actions and escalating to management when necessary.
• Assist in the review of Operating Memorandum, Service Level Agreements, Prospectus, internal policies, procedures working instructions & check-list, RCSA Matrix and any other related documentation.
• Remain up to date with all internal policies and ensure strict adherence to legal and regulatory requirements.
• Act as back-up of Head of Client Services and participate in the Management Committee of the Funds Accounting Unit when required Your profile
• Strong knowledge of financial products and funds regulation.
• Master's degree in Economics or Finance
• Min 10 years experience in Accounting
• Fluent in French and English
• In-depth understanding of Fund Administration and the relationships with the different stakeholders
• Experience in NAV calculations and NAV production
• Strong experience in financial reporting and audit process
• Good knowledge in foreign currency hedging and asset pooling techniques.
• Experience in fund events (merger, CIK/RIK, fund restructuring, etc.).
• Knowledge of Multifonds.
• Good knowledge in MS Office tool (mainly Excel).
• Flexibility - Can-do attitude
• Client oriented mindset.
• Sense of initiative and willing to learn.
• Strong analytical skills.
• Strong communication & presentation skills
• Rigorous and organized.
• Manage Stress and prioritization. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Pictet Tech division specializes in designing and integrating cutting-edge software applications, including advanced portfolio management systems, sophisticated trading platforms, and comprehensive banking and corporate solutions. As a key contributor to the Group’s strategic advancements, the division plays a vital role in driving transformative innovations that enhance our services and deliver exceptional value to our clients.

The Technical Business Analyst acts as a bridge between business stakeholders and development teams, supporting the Funds Platform with a particular focus on Transfer Agency (TA) processes. The role is responsible for understanding, analyzing, and translating business needs into effective technical solutions, ensuring the continuous improvement of business analysis practices and contributing to the overall success of the platform within the funds industry.

Your role

• Collaborate with business subject matter experts and stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for the funds platform, with a particular focus on Transfer Agency (TA) processes and operations.

• Translate business needs into clear, actionable IT requirements, user stories, and test scenarios using Agile methodologies and Jira.

• Propose and evaluate solution options in coordination with solution architects, considering existing systems, software, and market innovations (including AI).

• Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation, including specifications, process flows, and user guides.

• Lead project management activities as necessary, including stakeholder coordination, meeting facilitation, and milestone tracking.

• Conduct data analysis and support data-driven decision-making.

• Ensure the execution and delivery of IT projects in line with business requirements, timelines, and quality standards.

• Carry out functional acceptance testing, analyze production incidents, and support users during and after implementation.

• Contribute to process improvement initiatives by designing and implementing efficient workflows during system changes or migrations, focusing on innovation and optimization over replication of legacy processes

• Actively participate as a member of the Business Analyst Chapter; s hare knowledge, best practices, and drive the evolution of the business analysis discipline within the chapter

Your profile

• Min 5 years experience in a bank as Business Analyst

• Fluent in French and English

• Proven experience as a Business Analyst or Technical Business Analyst in the funds industry, with a strong focus on transfer agency processes.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; able to facilitate meetings and workshops.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a dynamic environment

• Project management experience, including organizing and leading cross-functional meetings.

• Fluent in English, French is an asset

• In-depth knowledge of transfer agency functions, including investor servicing, transaction processing, and related regulatory requirements.

• Experience with industry platforms and tools relevant to transfer agency (e.g., Multifonds TA, Fenergo); experience with system integrations and data migrations is a plus.

• Proficiency in SQL for data analysis and troubleshooting

• Experience working in Agile environments, with hands-on use of JIRA (and Confluence) for story management and project tracking.

• Ability to write clear, structured documentation and user stories.

• Familiarity with AI tools and their application in business analysis; experience implementing AI-driven solutions is a plus.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. Your role The scope of the function is to oversee all the workflow from the trade reception, data analysis and life cycle data management to instruments pricing. The scope of asset includes listed products (equities, bonds, loan, derivatives), OTC products (IRS,CDS, FX & Equity options, TRS, CFD…) and Structured products (autocall, Reverse convertible, dual currency deposit, accumulator, Airbag…).
• Integration and control of assets opening in our global platform Neoxam.
• Control and publish prices, greeks, market data and analytics.
• Life cycle management of all Assets.
• Set up the necessary files to complement these feeds.
• Introduce the necessary settings for queries and Data/pricing flows for securities newly registered in our systems from our various financial information providers (Bloomberg, SIX, Reuters and ICE).
• Regularly check and update these settings.
• Provide the assistance requested by the various users of these Data (accountants for investment funds, valuers, administrators, asset managers, wealth managers, etc.).
• Challenge of various assets type with the counterparty's prices.
• Liaise directly with our main stakeholders in case of issue. Your profile Requested experience:
• Master’s degree in Finance, economics.
• 2 to 5 years’ experience minimum in a similar position. Knowledge / technical skills:
• Good knowledge of financial products and good level in financial mathematic.
• Good knowledge of financial information providers.
• Skilled user of office software applications, especially Excel. Soft skills:
• Driven and capable of showing initiative in solving problems.
• An enquiring mind with strong learning skills and a well-developed critical faculty.
• Accuracy and thoroughness in searching for the information required to value securities.
• Good capacity to collaborate and find win-win solution. Language skills:
• French: fluent level
• English: good knowledge (written and spoken) Note We will not accept any CVs from agencies. In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description. Flexible and modern ways of working As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave. Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 31 offices in financial centers worldwide, currently employing more than 5’000 people. The group is owned and managed by eight partners and stands out as a company with an entrepreneurial spirit and loyalty. Pictet has been present in Zurich since 1982 where it employs over 200 people. The Zurich branch is located at the Leuenhof, one of the most historic buildings on the prestigious Bahnhofstrasse. We are looking for a passionate Chef de Rang to join our team in Zurich. As a key member of our motivated team, you will be working for Food & Beverage activities, in our beautiful premises in the heart of Zurich. You will bring your communication skills, your ability to work independently and your good knowledge of foreign languages to a service-oriented team that will appreciate your motivation, high quality standards and networked thinking. Your organizational skills and thoughtful approach to your work will enable you to maintain an overview even in hectic situations. You will use your sense of responsibility, pleasant manner and outstanding client focus to support our own staff as well as our clients. Your role You will manage the activities of the restaurant dedicated to the Bank's clients and management, as well as external and internal events (banquets and catering). You will be the main contact for the kitchen and reception teams and coordinate and perform all the Food & Beverage activities. As a Food & Beverage Coordinator, you provide a first-class Food & Beverage service with an emphasis on quality and always maintain absolute discretion. Working hours are primarily during office hours, with only occasional evening shifts. Your responsibilities include the following:
• Plan and organize client lunches and hospitality service with or without external catering service
• Ensure the setting up of lounges or banquets according to the reservation forecasts and menus
• Take orders and propose food and wine pairings, if necessary
• Manage the wine cellar in coordination with Geneva’s F&B team
• Monitor the service and ensure its excellence
• Help to prepare client-facing events
• Ensure the maintenance of the material (silverware, glasses...), as well as its inventory
• Perform general administrative duties
• Participate in the establishment and improvement of standards and procedures Your profile
• Hotel management training/apprenticeship
• At least 5 years of experience in a high-end hospitality environment or in a successful running restaurant
• Native German speaker, fluent in English and knowledge of French would be an advantage
• Service-oriented, smart and confident appearance
• Must be resident in Switzerland Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. The Role is to provide 1st level support on Fund Admnistration activities. To centralise, coordinate, and respond to Clients, Business Lines & Auditors requests and contribute to improvements of the processes, procedures and operational platforms to guarantee the proper application of controls and consistently exceed client’s needs and expectations. Your role
• Collaborate with Business Implementation Team, Client Relationship Managers (CRM), Management Companies and other key stakeholders (Custody Bank, Pricing, Transfer Agent (TA)…) on Projects & fund-related events.
• Act as the main liaison for both external and internal Clients, as well as Auditors, regarding all Fund Administration day-to-day activities.
• Manage the end-to-end Audit process for the funds, from initial planning & timetable, preparation and coordination of the financial statements to final approval and CSSF filling. Respond to Audit queries and ensure timely implementation of corrective actions and / or process improvement & automation as needed.
• Support Fund Administration Operations teams and effectively manage relationships across various business lines, including CRM, Business Implementation Team, TA , Tax, and others.
• Demonstrate a proactive mindset in addressing fund-related issues, actively challenge the status quo, and contribute innovative ideas for process enhancement.
• Participate in due diligence meetings, service reviews, Client visits, and Board meetings as required.
• Monitor internal and external KPIs and take actions when needed
• Manage and resolve internal and external escalations, taking appropriate actions and escalating to management when necessary.
• Assist in the review of Operating Memorandum, Service Level Agreements, Prospectus, internal policies, procedures working instructions & check-list, RCSA Matrix and any other related documentation.
• Remain up to date with all internal policies and ensure strict adherence to legal and regulatory requirements.
• Act as back-up of Head of Client Services and participate in the Management Committee of the Funds Accounting Unit when required Your profile
• Strong knowledge of financial products and funds regulation.
• Master's degree in Economics or Finance
• Min 10 years experience in Accounting
• Fluent in French and English
• In-depth understanding of Fund Administration and the relationships with the different stakeholders
• Experience in NAV calculations and NAV production
• Strong experience in financial reporting and audit process
• Good knowledge in foreign currency hedging and asset pooling techniques.
• Experience in fund events (merger, CIK/RIK, fund restructuring, etc.).
• Knowledge of Multifonds.
• Good knowledge in MS Office tool (mainly Excel).
• Flexibility - Can-do attitude
• Client oriented mindset.
• Sense of initiative and willing to learn.
• Strong analytical skills.
• Strong communication & presentation skills
• Rigorous and organized.
• Manage Stress and prioritization. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire principal des finances (contrat de 12 mois)

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra La divisione Corporate Functions comprende le attività non bancarie del Gruppo e comprende oltre 600 dipendenti. Personalizzato da specialisti con profonda competenza in tutte le linee aziendali, le funzioni centrali sono organizzate in vari dipartimenti di gruppo: Comunicazione, conformità, finanza, risorse umane, sicurezza dell'informazione, controllo interno, legale, ufficio aziendale, rischio e tassazione. Group Finance è dedicata a garantire una solida gestione finanziaria e reporting, supportando gli obiettivi strategici del Gruppo attraverso operazioni finanziarie efficaci, controlli interni forti e il rispetto dei requisiti normativi. Come membro della comunità delle Finanze del Gruppo, il Senior Finance Manager si unirà al team di Contabilità, Data & Reporting, segnalando al responsabile del reporting finanziario e delle soluzioni di reporting regolamentare. Il ruolo coinvolgerà una stretta collaborazione con tutti i membri del team Accounting, Data & Reporting, così come con altri team interni, per garantire l'efficace gestione delle operazioni finanziarie e reporting. Il tuo ruolo In qualità di Senior Finance Manager, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nella supervisione e nell'esecuzione dei processi finanziari fondamentali all'interno della funzione Finanza di Gruppo. Potrai sfruttare la tua forte competenza finanziaria e la comprensione del settore bancario per garantire l'accuratezza, l'integrità e la tempestività dei dati finanziari e la reportistica. Sarete responsabili dei seguenti compiti:
• Partecipare a progetti relativi alla finanza, compresi i miglioramenti dei processi, i miglioramenti del sistema e l'attuazione di nuovi requisiti normativi.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team The Corporate Functions division encompasses the Group’s non-banking activities and comprises over 600 employees. Staffed by specialists with deep expertise across all business lines, the central functions are organised into various group departments: Communication, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Corporate Office, Risk, and Taxation. Group Finance is dedicated to ensuring robust financial management and reporting, supporting the Group’s strategic objectives through effective financial operations, strong internal controls, and compliance with regulatory requirements. As a member of the Group Finance community, the Senior Finance Manager will join the Accounting, Data & Reporting team, reporting to the Head of Financial Reporting and Regulatory Reporting Solutions. The role will involve close collaboration with all members of the Accounting, Data & Reporting team, as well as with other internal teams, to ensure the effective management of financial operations and reporting. Your role As a Senior Finance Manager, you will play a key role in overseeing and executing core financial processes within the Group Finance function. You will leverage your strong finance expertise and understanding of the banking industry to ensure the accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of financial data and reporting. You will be responsible for the following tasks:
• Participate in finance-related projects, including process improvements, system enhancements, and implementation of new regulatory requirements.
• Oversee daily financial operations, including data maintenance, reconciliations, and operational controls to ensure accuracy and compliance.
• Contribute to the preparation and delivery of financial, regulatory and management reports, ensuring consistency with both regulatory standards and internal policies.
• Collaborate closely with all members of the Accounting, Data & Reporting team and other internal stakeholders, including Finance, Risk, and IT teams, to gather requirements, resolve issues, and drive process optimization.
• Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation, responding to queries, and implementing recommendations.
• Maintain the Internal Control System (ICS), to ensure adherence to internal policies and external regulations.
• Contribute to the development and documentation of finance processes and procedures. Your profile
• Master’s degree in Finance or equivalent.
• At least ten years’ experience in the banking industry within a Finance department and/or in external audit.
• Strong knowledge of financial reporting, accounting principles, and regulatory requirements in the banking sector.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial data and provide actionable insights.
• Proven experience in managing financial operations, controls, and reporting processes.
• Strong proactivity, adaptability, autonomy, curiosity, and a can-do attitude.
• Excellent collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and functional stakeholders.
• Fluent in French and English.
• Must be a resident in Switzerland. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies. Ihr Team Pictet Alternative Advisors ist ein führender alternativer Investmentspezialist mit Know-how in Hedge-Fonds, Private Equity und Global Real Estate. Das Genfer und Londoner Team baut, verwaltet und berät Portfolios alternativer Investitionslösungen für institutionelle und private Kunden. Die Gruppe hat in den kommenden Jahren starke Entwicklungsambitionen für Pictet Alternative Advisors, insbesondere um ihr Produktangebot auf zusätzliche Assetklassen auszudehnen und seine institutionellen Kundenbasis weiter zu entwickeln. Angesichts dieser Entwicklungen sucht Pictet Alternative Advisors einen Operations Officer, um seine Entwicklung zu steuern. Mit Sitz in Genf stoßen Sie an einem geschäftigen Team, das ein starkes Maß an Aktivität und Wachstum auf unserer alternativen Investment-Plattform unterstützt. Sie werden operative Unterstützung über eine diversifizierte Palette von Anlagestrategien sowie verwaltete Konten bieten. Ihre Rolle
• Verwaltung und Koordination von Operationen im Zusammenhang mit den Investitionsteams (Produkte und Mandate)
• Unterstützung der Investitionsteams, des Managements und der internen Kunden.
• Überwachung von NAV-Berechnungen, FX-Hedging, Reporting, Transaktionen und Client-Services.
• Koordination mit allen Dienstleistern (Recht, Steuer, Compliance, Administratoren, Backoffice usw.).
• Überwachung von Risiken und Investitionsbeschränkungen.
• Arbeiten an verschiedenen gelegentlichen und wiederkehrenden Projekten (z.B. TER-Berechnungen).
• Optimierung und Automatisierung von Prozessen (IT-Entwicklung). Ihr Profil
• mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle in einer Fondsabteilung oder mit einem Asset Manager.
• Bewährtes praktisches Wissen über alternative Produkte (Hedge Funds, Private Equity, Real Estate) Betriebsmanagement.
• Rigorous, mit hervorragenden Zahlenfähigkeiten und eine scharfe Liebe zum Detail.
• Eine gewisse Fähigkeit, sich mit Fragen/Themen mit Spezialisten aus verschiedenen Unternehmen (Investment Manager, Steuer, Compliance, etc.) zu beschäftigen, mit exzellenten verbalen und schriftlichen Fähigkeiten in diesen besonderen Situationen.
• Erweiterter Benutzer von Excel und im Allgemeinen mit neuen IT-Systemen. Ideal mit einem KI Interesse oder Erfahrung.
• Leichte Ausdrücke in Französisch und Englisch, mit dem entsprechenden schriftlichen Abschluss, um Dokumente zu erstellen und komplexe Angelegenheiten mit internen und externen Parteien zu diskutieren, ob Muttersprachlern oder nicht.

Votre équipe Pictet Alternative Advisors est un spécialiste de l'investissement alternatif de premier plan avec une expertise en fonds spéculatifs, en fonds propres et en immobilier mondial. L'équipe basée à Genève et à Londres construit, gère et conseille des portefeuilles de solutions d'investissement alternatives pour les clients institutionnels et privés. Le Groupe a de fortes ambitions de développement pour Pictet Alternative Advisors pour les années à venir, notamment pour élargir son offre de produits afin d'inclure des classes d'actifs supplémentaires et pour développer sa clientèle institutionnelle. Compte tenu de ces développements, Pictet Alternative Advisors cherche à embaucher un agent des opérations pour diriger son développement. Basée à Genève, vous rejoindrez une équipe très occupée au cœur de la croissance et de l'activité de notre plateforme d'investissement alternative. Vous fournirez un soutien opérationnel dans un éventail diversifié de stratégies d'investissement, ainsi que des comptes gérés. Votre rôle
• Gestion et coordination des opérations liées aux équipes d'investissement (produits et mandats)
• Fournir un appui aux équipes d'investissement, à la direction et aux clients internes.
• Suivi des calculs de NAV, de la couverture FX, des rapports, des transactions et des services à la clientèle.
• Coordination avec tous les prestataires de services (juridique, fiscal, conformité, administrateurs, back-office, etc.).
• Suivi des risques et des contraintes d'investissement.
• Travail sur divers projets occasionnels et récurrents (par exemple calculs TER).
• Optimisation et automatisation des processus (développement des technologies de l'information). Votre profil
• Au moins cinq ans d'expérience dans un rôle similaire dans un département de fonds ou avec un gestionnaire d'actifs.
• Connaissance pratique éprouvée de la gestion des opérations de produits alternatifs (fonds de couverture, fonds d'investissement privés, immobilier).
• Rigieuse, avec d'excellentes compétences en calcul et une attention particulière au détail.
• Une certaine capacité à traiter des questions/thèmes avec des spécialistes de diverses entreprises (gestionnaires d'investissements, fiscalité, conformité, etc.), avec d'excellentes compétences verbales et écrites dans ces situations particulières.
• Utilisateur avancé d'Excel et généralement à l'aise avec les nouveaux systèmes informatiques. Idéalement avec un intérêt ou une expérience d'IA.
• À l'aise de s'exprimer en français et en anglais, avec la compétence écrite nécessaire pour rédiger la documentation et discuter de questions complexes avec les parties internes et externes, qu'elles soient ou non de langue maternelle.
• Doit résider en Suisse ou vouloir déménager. En tant que candidat choisi, vous ferez preuve d'énergie et d'enthousiasme dans votre travail et serez rigoureux dans votre approche. Vous vous démarquerez également en raison de vos excellentes compétences en travail d'équipe. De plus, vous serez digne de confiance, capable de faire preuve de discrétion et garder à l'esprit que les intérêts et l'excellence du client dans ce que vous livrez est ce qui compte le plus. Remarque Nous n'accepterons aucun CV par l'intermédiaire des agences Diversité et inclusion Pictet est un employeur à chances égales et s'engage à créer un environnement diversifié. Nous respectons toutes les personnes et nous cherchons à les inclure dans le milieu de travail. Appliquer Enregistrer l'emploi Courriel à un contact Retour à la liste

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. You will be a member of the Quality Control & Mobile team , reporting to the head of the team. In this role you will work on quality-control-related activities for the three teams ( Fund Accounting, Transfer Agency and Private Equity ) and occasionally provide support to the production teams during peak periods. Your role You will assist our Quality Control & Mobile team for the fund operations processes :
• Providing support operational teams in their daily tasks,
• Identifying areas of improvement in terms of the process and control framework,
• Contributing to the implementation of key quality control deliverables such as KPIs and the procedure framework review,
• Contributing to any other transversal project aimed at improving service delivery. Your profile Qualifications and experience:
• Pursuing a university degree in Finance, Economics or a related field. Specific knowledge:
• Knowledge in fund operations,
• Experience in process and data analysis,
• Project management and organizational skills,
• Good Excel and PowerPoint skills. Language skills:
• Spoken fluency in English and French. Personal qualities:
• Flexibility and agility,
• Strong interpersonal skills that enable effective communication and collaboration with colleagues and clients. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

La tua squadra

A Pictet, le nostre divisioni Technology and Operations lavorano in stretta collaborazione per fornire soluzioni innovative, sicure ed efficienti che spingono il successo del Gruppo. La divisione Technology sviluppa e integra soluzioni software avanzate, come sistemi di gestione del portafoglio, piattaforme di trading e applicazioni bancarie, giocando un ruolo chiave nella trasformazione digitale del Gruppo e nella creazione del valore del cliente. La divisione Operazioni garantisce il trattamento sicuro ed efficiente delle transazioni bancarie e dei fondi di investimento, mantenendo la conformità normativa e la gestione dei rischi operativi per supportare l'affidabilità dei nostri servizi finanziari.

Insieme, la tecnologia e le operazioni costituiscono la spina dorsale della capacità di Pictet di offrire esperienze client eccezionali, svolgendo un ruolo chiave nella trasformazione digitale del Gruppo e nella creazione di valore.

Sarai parte del team Finance Pictet Tech & Operations. Il team svolge un ruolo fondamentale nello sterzo finanziario della divisione, fornendo dati finanziari tempestivi e rilevanti e report nell'allineamento delle strategie finanziarie con gli obiettivi aziendali e fornendo informazioni attuabili agli stakeholder.

Il tuo ruolo

Come membro del team Finance Tech & Operations, possiederai lo sviluppo di dashboard finanziari, gestirai modelli di dati analitici finanziari, automatizza i processi di produzione di report e agirai come principale collegamento di finanza con il team Central Data Engineering. Contribuirai sia alla continuità operativa dei processi finanziari sia alla trasformazione a più lungo termine dell'analisi delle finanze all'interno della Pictet Technology and Operations.

• Assicurare la coerenza e l'integrità dei dati attraverso gli strati di reporting di finanza e le pipeline di dati a monte.
• Sviluppare e gestire il modello di dati analitici finanziari, assicurando che riflette con precisione le ultime opinioni analitiche.
• Guidare l'automazione dei processi di produzione e reporting dei dati finanziari, eliminando i flussi di lavoro manuali e migliorando l'affidabilità e la frequenza dei report finanziari.
• Progettazione, costruzione e manutenzione di cruscotti finanziari che coprono P&L per prodotto, allocazione dei costi e KPI operativi allineati con nuovo modello operativo.
• Supporto FP&A e attività di gestione contabile con analisi robuste e scalabili.

Il tuo profilo

• Laurea magistrale in informatica, scienza dei dati, ingegneria o un campo correlato.
• 3-5 anni di esperienza come analista di dati – esperienza di collaborazione con i team finanziari è un vantaggio.
• Forte competenza in SQL, pitone e esperienza con strumenti di visualizzazione.
• Eccellente capacità analitiche e di problem solving, con un'attenta attenzione ai dettagli.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di collegare gli stakeholder tecnici (Data Engineering) e aziendali (Finance).
• Automotivato, proattivo e in grado di lavorare in modo indipendente.
• Volontà di imparare e adattarsi a nuove tecnologie e strumenti.
• Residente in Svizzera o disposto a trasferirsi.

Your team

At Pictet, our Technology and Operations divisions work in close partnership to deliver innovative, secure, and efficient solutions that drive the Group’s success. The Technology division develops and integrates advanced software solutions, such as portfolio management systems, trading platforms, and banking applications – playing a key role in the Group’s digital transformation and client value creation. The Operations division ensures the secure and efficient processing of banking transactions and investment funds, maintaining regulatory compliance and managing operational risks to support the reliability of our financial services.

Together, Technology and Operations form the backbone of Pictet’s ability to deliver outstanding client experiences, playing a key role in the Group’s digital transformation and value creation.

You will be part of the Finance Pictet Tech & Operations team. The team plays a pivotal role in the financial steering of the division, by providing timely, relevant financial data and reports in aligning financial strategies with business objectives and delivering actionable insights to stakeholders.

Your role

As a member of the Finance Tech & Operations team, you will own the development of financial dashboards, manage finance analytical data models, automate reporting production processes, and act as the primary Finance liaison with the Central Data Engineering team. You will contribute to both the operational continuity of financial processes and the longer-term transformation of Finance analytics within Pictet Technology and Operations.

• Ensure data consistency and integrity across finance reporting layers and upstream data pipelines.
• Develop and manage the finance analytical data model, ensuring it accurately reflects latest analytical views.
• Drive the automation of finance data production and reporting processes, eliminating manual workflows and enhancing the reliability and frequency of financial reporting.
• Design, build, and maintain financial dashboards covering P&L by product, cost allocation, and operational KPIs aligned with new operating model.
• Support FP&A and management accounting activities with robust, scalable analytics.

Your profile

• Master’s degree in computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field.
• 3-5 years of experience as a data analyst – experience collaborating with finance teams is a plus.
• Strong proficiency in SQL, python, and experience with visualisation tools.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical (Data Engineering) and business (Finance) stakeholders.
• Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently.
• Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and tools.
• Resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies.

Ref. : FDA/CC/FAA

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Ihr Team

Unsere Divisionen Technologie und Operations arbeiten bei Pictet in enger Partnerschaft, um innovative, sichere und effiziente Lösungen zu schaffen, die den Erfolg des Konzerns vorantreiben. Der Bereich Technologie entwickelt und integriert fortschrittliche Softwarelösungen, wie Portfoliomanagement-Systeme, Handelsplattformen und Banking-Anwendungen – eine Schlüsselrolle in der digitalen Transformation und der Wertschöpfung der Gruppe. Der Geschäftsbereich Operationen gewährleistet die sichere und effiziente Abwicklung von Bankgeschäften und Investmentfonds, die Einhaltung regulatorischer Compliance und das Management operativer Risiken zur Unterstützung der Zuverlässigkeit unserer Finanzdienstleistungen.

Gemeinsam bilden Technologie und Operationen das Rückgrat von Pictets Fähigkeit, herausragende Kundenerfahrungen zu liefern, eine Schlüsselrolle in der digitalen Transformation und Wertschöpfung der Gruppe zu spielen.

Sie werden Teil des Finance Pictet Tech & Operations Teams sein. Das Team spielt eine zentrale Rolle bei der Finanzlenkung der Division, indem es zeitnahe, relevante Finanzdaten und Berichte zur Ausrichtung von Finanzstrategien mit Geschäftszielen und zur Bereitstellung von handlungsfähigen Erkenntnissen an Interessenvertreter gibt.

Ihre Rolle

Als Mitglied des Finance Tech & Operations Teams besitzen Sie die Entwicklung von Finanz-Dashboards, verwalten Finanzanalysedatenmodelle, automatisieren Reporting-Produktionsprozesse und fungieren als primäre Finanz-Verbindung mit dem Central Data Engineering Team. Sie werden sowohl zur operativen Kontinuität von Finanzprozessen als auch zur langfristigen Transformation von Finanzanalysen in Pictet Technology und Operations beitragen.

• Gewährleistung der Datenkonsistenz und -integrität über Finanzberichte und vorgelagerte Datenpipelines.
• Entwicklung und Verwaltung des Finanzanalytischen Datenmodells, um sicherzustellen, dass es die neuesten analytischen Ansichten genau widerspiegelt.
• Die Automatisierung von Finanzdatenproduktions- und Berichtsprozessen, die Beseitigung manueller Workflows und die Verbesserung der Zuverlässigkeit und Häufigkeit der Finanzberichterstattung.
• Konzipieren, bauen und pflegen finanzielle Dashboards, die P&L nach Produkt, Kostenzuweisung und operativen Kennzahlen abdecken, die mit dem neuen Betriebsmodell übereinstimmen.
• Unterstützung von FP&A- und Management-Buchungsaktivitäten mit robusten, skalierbaren Analysen.

Ihr Profil

• Master-Abschluss in Informatik, Datenwissenschaft, Ingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Bereich.
• 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung als Data Analyst – Erfahrung in Zusammenarbeit mit Finanzteams ist ein Plus.
• Starke Kenntnisse in SQL, Python und Erfahrung mit Visualisierungstools.
• Ausgezeichnete analytische und Problemlösung Fähigkeiten, mit viel Liebe zum Detail.
• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, technische (Data Engineering) und Business (Finance) Stakeholder zu überbrücken.
• Selbstmotiviert, proaktiv und selbständig arbeiten können.
• Bereitschaft, neue Technologien und Werkzeuge zu lernen und anzupassen.
• Wohnsitz in der Schweiz oder bereit, sich zu verlagern.

Anmerkung

Wir werden keine Lebensläufe über Agenturen akzeptieren.

Ref.: FDA/CC/ FAO

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services. Pictet Asset Services provides custody, fund services and trading solutions for external asset managers, fund managers and institutional clients. We manage every aspect of the asset servicing value chain and our range of bespoke solutions include value-adding analytics, trading strategy support and digital front-end interfaces designed to provide an unrivalled customer experience. The role of the function is to ensure the smooth running of the publishing production according to the SLAs, deadlines and roadmaps in place for in-house and third-party funds. A high level of client support (internal and external) will be expected. Your role
• Code request as part of fund launch process (LEI, Bloomberg Tickers, etc…).
• Set up, control / update of static and dynamic data.
• Contribute to the efficient and accurate execution of publishing operations.
• Activate and publish request according to registration status.
• Disseminate legal fund documentations, monthly portfolio reports and No NAV calculation reports.
• Manage the chargeback of invoices.
• Collect and organize documents.
• Scan and archive documents and data. Your profile Knowledge /Technical skills:
• Master's degree in Finance, Economics or related
• 2-year experience in banking sector
• Good knowledge in fund operations, process and data analysis
• In-depth knowledge of MS Office and banking softwares (Multifonds, Luxis and Avaloq)
• Excellent knowledge of operational banking and legal perspective for funds
• Good knowledge in Python programming and being at ease with the use of AI Tools would be considered as distinguishing factors. Soft skills:
• Rigor
• Attention to detail
• Organizational skills
• Team spirit
• Problem solving abilities Language skills
• Fluent in french and english Note We will not accept any CVs from agencies. In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description. Flexible and modern ways of working As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave. Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.
