Your team

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people.

Your role

Pictet is seeking to recruit a Marketing Manager (1-Year Contract) to work in the Marketing Asia - HKG team to support and coordinate marketing activities for Pictet Asset Management in Asia excluding Japan, contributing to brand visibility and business development in the region.

• Coordinate and execute regional marketing strategies and campaigns, including advertising, events, web, social media, and other marketing initiatives.

• Assist in the development and production of marketing collaterals, from information and data collection through to distribution, ensuring consistency with brand guidelines.

• Monitor the publication of global marketing content and support local content production and translation, liaising with external service providers as needed.

• Demonstrate creativity in developing innovative marketing campaigns and designing thoughtful client gifts that are highly valued and appreciated by recipients.

• Work closely with internal stakeholders, including local business teams, compliance, and headquarter marketing counterparts, to deliver marketing activities.

• Help maintain and update the firm’s web, digital, and social media platforms, ensuring content is accurate and engaging.

• Manage relationships with external vendors for the production of marketing assets, campaigns, events, and other communications materials.

• Track and report on marketing performance using analytics and KPIs, providing insights for ongoing improvement.

Your profile

• University graduate in Marketing, Communications, or a relevant discipline.

• 5-10 years of solid marketing and communications experience in financial institutions is highly preferred.

• Strong attention to detail and creativity.

• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and desktop publishing tools.

• Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) in English and Chinese.

• Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively in a diverse, multicultural environment.

• A proactive, results-oriented team player with a passion for marketing.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

descriptionByLocale.it:
Votre équipe Pictet Asset Services (PAS) propose des services de banque dépositaire, des services liés aux fonds ainsi que des solutions de trading à des gérants indépendants, à des gestionnaires de fonds et à des clients institutionnels. Nous maîtrisons en interne chaque dimension de l’asset servicing et concevons des solutions sur mesure, telles que des outils analytiques à valeur ajoutée, des supports à l’élaboration de stratégies de trading et des interfaces utilisateurs, pour offrir une expérience client inégalée. Votre rôle - Etre le contact principal pour un portefeuille de gérants indépendants (GI). - Offrir un support et résoudre les problèmes pour toutes les thématiques opérationnelles et administratives. - Participer au processus administratif de mise en place des relations GI et de leurs comptes clients, en collaboration avec les chargés de relations (CRM). - Traiter les opérations de paiement et de transfert, en veillant à ce que les appels de vérification (call-back) soient effectués de manière systématique, et fournir un soutien pour les autres types de transactions, selon les besoins. - Traiter les demandes (codifications clients internes, cartes de crédit, limites de crédit, conditions spéciales, etc.) et effectuer les saisies dans les workflows correspondants. - Gérer le flux documentaire (archivage, traitement des formulaires physiques et électroniques). - Bien connaître les principaux partenaires internes, établir avec eux d’étroites relations et être leur interlocuteur/trice de référence pour le portefeuille. - Veiller à ce que la prise des appels téléphoniques soit assurée au sein de l’équipe et fournir un soutien pour les tâches administratives. - Appliquer les politiques et directives en vigueur et accompagner la mise en œuvre de nouvelles règles. Votre profil - Formation bancaire ou jugée équivalente. - Expérience de 5 ans dans le support aux GI. - Excellentes connaissances transversales au niveau des flux opérationnels. - Sens du service à la clientèle. - Solide esprit d’équipe. - Aptitude à communiquer avec une grande aisance. - Sens développé des responsabilités, résistance au stress et capacité à gérer des situations délicates. - Sens de l’organisation et de la gestion des priorités. - Très bonne connaissance des outils informatiques usuels MS Office/Avaloq. - Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, tant à l’écrit qu’à l’oral. - Domicile en Suisse requis. Note CRO/FH/AA We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) is a leading alternative investment specialist and wholly owned subsidiary of the Pictet Group, with expertise in hedge funds, private equity and global real estate. With teams based around the world, the PAA teams construct, manage and advise on portfolios of alternative investment solutions for institutional and private clients. The Group has strong growth ambitions for PAA for the years ahead, notably to expand its product offering to include additional asset classes and to further develop its institutional client base. Based in Geneva, you will become part of a dynamic five-person team on a six-month temporary contract, assisting with a rise in workload and activity. Your role will involve offering operational support for both hedge fund portfolios and managed accounts. Your role
• Managing and coordinating operations linked to PAA’s hedge fund products and mandates (NAV calculations, reporting, transactions and client services).
• Providing support to the investment teams, management and internal clients.
• Coordinating with all service providers (legal, tax, compliance, administrators, back office, etc.).
• Monitoring risks and investment constraints.
• Working on various occasional and recurrent projects (e.g. TER calculations). Your profile
• At least five years’ experience in a similar role in a fund department or with an asset manager.
• Proven practical knowledge of hedge fund operations management.
• Rigorous, with excellent numeracy skills and a keen attention to detail.
• A certain ability to deal with issues/topics with specialists from various businesses (investment managers, tax, compliance, etc.), with excellent verbal and writing skills in these particular situations.
• Advanced user of Excel and generally at ease with new IT systems. Use of Webfolio is a plus.
• At ease expressing yourself in both French and English, with the relevant written proficiency to draft documentation and discuss complex matters with both internal and external parties, whether native speakers or not.
• A strong interest in and/or experience with AI would be an asset.
• Must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. Your team The Pictet Group is a leading independent wealth and asset management firm operating globally. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group maintains operations in 30 offices across key financial centers worldwide, employing more than 4,600 professionals. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.

By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Your role

• Monitor orders for UCI share subscriptions/redemptions, transfers and conversions.

• Prepare and send out confirmations and reports to promoters, distributors and other fund intermediaries.

• Respond rapidly to different requests from clients (inside and outside the Group) to guarantee that a quality service is provided that meets the requirements of a demanding client.

• Manage client commissions and dividends for in-house and third-party funds.

• Manage events on Funds (in kind transfers, launches, liquidations…).

• Work on automating various configurations within the tool “Multifonds Global Investor”, primarily focusing on Fund setup, by implementing key controls.

• Play a coordinating role in fund-related events across teams, including fund launches, compartments, classes, mergers, and liquidations.

• Review Fund’s prospectuses to ensure alignment between promoter requests and system feasibility.

• Offer technical and functional support to other teams within the service.

Your profile

• Extensive knowledge of the Transfer Agent business and all-round understanding of fund administration processes

• Unversity degree in Economics or Finance

• 5 years' experience in similar position

• Fluent in french and english

• Excellent knowledge of the “MFGI - Multifonds Global Investor” tool and proven experience in its usage.

• Extensive knowledge of the Office suite.

• SQL knowledge is a must have.

• Flexibility

• Ability to handle stress.

• Rigor in checking, sending, confirming and monitoring orders.

• Enthusiasm and drive and ability to show initiative in solving problems.

• Enquiring mind and ability to learn quickly.

• Team player.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.

By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Your role

• Monitoring of the team mailbox and allocation of queries;

• Handling Beneficial Owner monitoring requests;

• Preparation of clients due diligence and audits visits;

• Handling reporting’s register related questions;

• Assisting on general mailings to investors;

• Archiving investor documents;

• Communicating professionally with internal and external clients.

Your profile

• A Master's in Finance, Economics or Engineering.

• A first experience, in the field of AML/KYC and/or a Compliance function.

• Good knowledge of the funds industry and the different stakeholders involved.

• Written and spoken fluency in French and English.

• Meticulous, detail oriented and organized with highest quality deliveries.

• Able to meet deadlines, prioritise and multi-task

• Ability to communicate clearly and promptly

Experience in the following would be a major advantage:

• At first experience working with the account opening or ongoing due diligence processes.

• Knowledge of Luxembourg AML/KYC regulations; knowledge of the different roles in the investment fund industry (asset management, custodian bank, transfer agent and fund administration) as well as of the related regulatory framework.

• Any FATCA/CRS experience or knowledge.

• ACAMS certification or equivalent.

• Experience using AML tools (World-Check, Pythagoras, Factiva) and public sources (RBE, Signature.net).

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Votre équipe FundPartner Solutions propose une gamme complète de services d’administration de fonds et de création de fonds sur mesure. Ses équipes de spécialistes apportent leurs compétences en matière de domiciliation, d’enregistrement et de gouvernance de fonds, ainsi que de gestion des risques et de contrôle du respect des directives de placement. En tant que Business Compliance & Operations Liaison Officer vous serez responsable de la gestion et de la coordination des projets entre les diverses équipes de la société ainsi qu’avec les prestataires externes de type gestionnaires de fortune collective. Vous assurerez un support opérationnel de qualité, coordonnerez les flux d’information et veillerez à la conformité des processus liés à l’administration et à la gouvernance des fonds d’investissement de droit suisse. Ce rôle est essentiel pour garantir une efficience optimale et le respect des exigences réglementaires lors de la mise en place et du suivi de fonds d’investissements. Votre rôle
• Agir comme point de contact principal pour les équipes internes (juridique, compliance, risques, administration fonds) sur les aspects opérationnels et administratifs.
• Gérer la coordination légale et opérationnelle des projets liés à la mise en place de nouveaux fonds ou mandats de gestion, en collaboration avec les départements internes et externes (gérants, autorité, audit, etc).
• Coordonner et suivre les projets clients, en veillant à la collecte des documents, au respect des délais et à la bonne communication entre les parties prenantes pour assurer leur mise en œuvre.
• Assurer la mise à jour, la gestion et la publication des données des fonds de placement dans les systèmes internes, ainsi que la production de rapports réglementaires et opérationnels.
• Gérer la coordination et la préparation administrative des demandes provenant de diverses autorités (FINMA, AFC, etc) ainsi que des demandes d’audit interne et externe participer aux activités et tâches liées à la gouvernance d’entreprise.
• Soutenir opérationnellement les équipes dans le suivi et l’implémentation des documents et des contrats de la société et participer au processus clé de vérification nécessaires pour les divers processus de la société.
• Participer à l’amélioration continue des processus, à l’optimisation des outils de travail et à la préparation de documents pour les clients et comités internes. Votre profil
• Solide expérience (5-10 ans) dans le secteur bancaire ou financier, avec formation supérieure (Bachelor ou équivalent).
• Bonne connaissance des produits financiers et des processus opérationnels en environnement financier.
• Maîtrise des réglementations suisses et internationales, avec curiosité et capacité à en comprendre les enjeux.
• Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais (l’allemand est un atout), avec de bonnes compétences en communication.
• Maîtrise des outils MS Office et sens de l’organisation pour gérer plusieurs tâches en parallèle.
• Esprit d’équipe, orientation client, rigueur, autonomie et capacité à résoudre des problèmes.
• Domicile en Suisse requis. Note BCLO/FH/IM We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. Pictet Asset Services provides custody, fund services and trading solutions for external asset managers, fund managers and institutional clients. We manage every aspect of the asset servicing value chain and our range of bespoke solutions include value-adding analytics, trading strategy support and digital front-end interfaces designed to provide an unrivalled customer experience. As an intern within the Pictet Asset Services department, you will support the Client Relationship Management (CRO/CRM) teams in their daily activities. This internship will allow you to develop operational, regulatory, and interpersonal skills while contributing to the quality of client service.
• Start date: August/September
• Duration: 12 months
• Employment rate: part-time
• Prerequisite: a tripartite internship agreement signed with your school Your role
• Provide daily operational support to the teams in managing client files: preparation, verification, and follow-up of documents required for account opening, modification, or closure.
• Assist in the management of routine operations: signature verification, execution and monitoring of transactions (orders, payments, fund and asset transfers), management of incoming/outgoing flows, coordination with counterparties, and alerting in case of blockages.
• Participate in the preparation and updating of client files, ensuring information compliance and completeness of supporting documents.
• Support the teams in handling client requests, processing queries, and resolving simple incidents, ensuring rigorous follow-up and effective communication.
• Contribute to verifying the accuracy of transactions and the quality of data entered into internal tools.
• Act as a point of contact for administrative and logistical tasks related to client relationship management. Your profile Qualifications and experience:
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration or Economics.
• First experience (internship) in a client relationship management role within the financial services industry, idealy in private banking or wealth management Personal qualities:
• Attention to detail and organizational skills
• Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
• Strong interpersonal skills and a team-oriented mindset
• Proactive and solution-oriented approach Language Skills:
• French: fluent level
• English: good knowledge (written and spoken) Note Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 27 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5300 people. Pictet has been present in London since 1990, and employs approximately 400 people. Pictet Asset Management (PAM) manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions, financial intermediaries and their clients. Our culture welcomes independent thinkers and centres around investment excellence, a long-term perspective and a dedication to client service. The PAM London HR team includes Generalist, Learning & Development and Reward & Benefits specialisms. Together, we partner with the business to provide comprehensive and high-touch support to approximately 300 PAM employees as well as delivering local HR support to colleagues in Pictet Wealth Management and Pictet Alternative Advisors. Your role Reporting to the Senior HR Business Partner, you will act as a trusted partner to defined client groups across PAM‘s enabling functions where you will be responsible for leading on all people related topics. This includes: › Recruitment: Collaborate with managers to understand hiring rationale, shape & execute the recruitment strategy including influencing job descriptions, sourcing strategy and interview structure as well as sharing insightful interview feedback. Support the hiring decision process and design offers with input from the Reward team. › Compensation & Benefits: Support managers through a seamless annual compensation review cycle, sharing input on salary reviews and bonus decisions. Act as the first point of contact for benefits related questions, calling on the guidance of the Reward team where needed. › Performance Management: Work closely with managers to ensure effective performance management practises are in place including objective setting, mid-years, and appraisals whilst fostering a culture of ongoing feedback. › Employee Relations: Serve as a trusted advisor on employee relations matters providing guidance on performance management practises, conflict resolution and disciplinary actions for example. › Talent Management: Guide managers through succession planning and talent mapping, supporting client groups to build a strong, skills focused talent pipeline. Support employees in their own development which may include advising on internal mobility, secondment opportunities etc. › Organisational Design & Employee Engagement : Provide advice on organisational design & structure and champion employee engagement initiatives to foster a culture of high performance and engagement. › Ensure all operational & life-cycle processes for dedicated client area run smoothly and effectively. For example, responsible for executing new joiner onboarding, amendments, leavers processes etc. › Support the broader Generalist HR team on regulatory change, process improvements, and policy updates. Your profile › At least five years’ HR experience in a fast-paced high-performance environment delivering the best possible outcomes for the business. › Sound knowledge of UK employment laws, employee relations, and regulations and the ability to apply them in live business scenarios. › Proven ability to manage stakeholders, influence, and navigate multiple priorities. › Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build credible relationships across the business. › Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to manage complex and sensitive employee relations matters. Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies. HRBP/RF/CB Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace. Apply Save Job Email to a contact Return to List

In time, lead recruitment processes end to end with an initial focus on temporary roles. › Onboarding : Accompany new joiners from the point of signature to their first day in a seamless onboarding journey using SuccessFactors modules. Ownership of content & delivery of new joiner inductions, benefits briefings etc. Key liaison with IT, Compliance etc to ensure new joiner’s have full set-up from day one. › Benefits : Act as the first point of contact for benefits related questions, calling on the guidance of the Reward team where needed. › Ensure all operational & life-cycle processes run smoothly and effectively. For example, amendment letters, departure processes, background screenings, reference requests etc. › Employee Relations : Support HR BPs where needed or when a learning opportunity is available. For example, note taking during disciplinary, grievances or sickness absence processes. › Support the broader Generalist HR team on regulatory change, process improvements, and policy updates. Your profile › Approximately 1 years’ experience in a fast-paced high-performance environment delivering the best possible outcomes for the business. This could be within a HR, Recruitment, or Team Assistant role. › Experience using SuccessFactors, Icertis, and Docusign alongside an automation mindset are advantageous. › Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build credible relationships across the business. › Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. descriptionByLocale.it:
Your team Pictet Tech designs, integrates and operates software applications ranging from portfolio management systems and trading platforms to banking and corporate solutions. The division is responsible for some of the Group’s key innovations while sustaining business operations. You’ll be part of the Cloud Engineering unit. In this unit, we are responsible of streamlining the development experience of product teams by delivering reliable and user-centric platforms covering observability, identity, continuous integration and delivery, release management and cloud capabilities. You will be embedded within the Release Management Team and will help building and maintaining the tooling used to manage and govern the release management at Pictet Tech . Your role
• Designing, building and operating a reliable platform providing release management capabilities to development teams.
• Contributing to the promotion of good practices in terms of Release Management within Pictet Group.
• Aligning with developers, infrastructure engineers, cybersecurity and risk managers to apply standards and to provide guidance.
• Performing tasks expected of a platform engineer: development, infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines. Your profile
• You have experience in an engineering role (e.g., software engineer, devops, etc.).
• Proficiency in software craftsmanship practices and full stack development (i.e. Java, Spring, Typescript, Angular, Next.js).
• A well-established background in vibe coding paired with a strong passion for AI coding.
• Knowledge about architecture topics such as integration, security, network, identity and access management.
• Strong interest and knowledge of release management processes.
• As a plus, you have expertise in releasing core banking systems or such complex systems within a highly regulated environment.
• Team player with strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Deeply curious and eager to learn technologies and skills.
• Fluent in French and English.
• Swiss resident. Ref: DOE/CRO/XC Note We will not accept any CVs via agencies Diversity & Inclusion Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. descriptionByLocale.en:
業務概要

オルタナティブ投資の中でも、プライベート資産（プライベートエクイティ、プライベートデット、不動産）およびこれらの低流動性資産を組み入れるマルチアセット戦略の開発を担当するプロダクトスペシャリストとして、受託者責任（fiduciary）および説明責任（accountability）を果たしつつ、ビジネスの拡大に貢献していただきます。

金融市場およびプライベート資産に関する専門知識を活かし、グローバル運用部門や営業部門など関連部署と連携しながら新規案件の獲得や既存案件の管理を行います。さらに、商品開発・マーケティング・バックオフィス等の社内ステークホルダーと協働し、クライアントニーズに即した商品組成やソリューション構築、マルチアセット戦略の開発に積極的に関与していただきます。

主な職務内容

• 顧客への運用ソリューションの提案

• 担当プロダクトの顧客向け説明およびビジネスデベロップメント活動（営業部門との協働）

• プライベート資産等の低流動性資産を組み入れるマルチアセット戦略の企画・開発

• 担当プロダクトの運用状況の把握、運用報告会や運用報告書等での説明

• RFPや顧客からの質問への対応（RFPチームと協働）

• 担当プロダクトに関する戦略、運用モニタリングおよびデューデリジェンス

• プロダクトの品質維持・管理

• その他関連業務

※グローバルの運用チーム、プロダクト・スペシャリスト部門、商品本部内の他部門（商品開発、RFP、運用データ分析等）、営業部門、その他関連部門と連携し、上記業務を遂行していただきます。

望ましい経験・最低経験年数

• 金融業界（運用会社、証券会社等）における5年超の経験

• プライベート資産（プライベートエクイティ、プライベートデット、不動産）に関連する知識、業務経験

descriptionByLocale.it:
Responsabile della gestione di strategie di investimento alternative che includono asset privati (private equity, private debt, immobiliare) e asset a bassa liquidità, con l'obbligo di responsabilità fiduciaria e di spiegazione, contribuendo allo sviluppo aziendale.

Utilizzando le competenze nel mercato finanziario e negli asset privati, collaborerà con i dipartimenti globali di gestione e vendita per acquisire nuovi clienti e gestire quelli esistenti. Inoltre, lavorerà con gli stakeholder interni come sviluppo prodotto, marketing, back office, per creare composizioni di prodotti e soluzioni su misura per i clienti, sviluppando strategie multi-asset.

Principali compiti:

• Proporre soluzioni operative ai clienti
• Spiegare i prodotti assegnati ai clienti e svolgere attività di sviluppo aziendale (in collaborazione con il dipartimento vendite)
• Pianificare e sviluppare strategie multi-asset che includano asset a bassa liquidità come private equity, private debt e immobiliare
• Monitorare lo stato operativo dei prodotti assegnati, presentare e spiegare durante riunioni e report operativi
• Rispondere a RFP e domande dei clienti (in collaborazione con la squadra RFP)
• Monitorare strategia, operatività e diligenza dovuta per i prodotti assegnati
• Garantire la qualità dei prodotti
• Altre attività correlate

• Collaborerà con il team globale di gestione, il dipartimento Specialisti Prodotto, altri dipartimenti all'interno del Product Management (sviluppo prodotto, RFP, analisi dati operativi), il dipartimento vendite e altri dipartimenti correlati.

Esperienza desiderabile e minima:

• 5 anni o più di esperienza nel settore finanziario (aziende di gestione, società di brokeraggio, ecc.)
• Conoscenze e esperienza nel settore degli asset privati (private equity, private debt, immobiliare)

Lingue:
• Inglese: livello business
• Giapponese: livello madrelingua

Nota:
Non accetteremo CV tramite agenzie.

Diversità e Inclusione:
Pictet è un'azienda che si impegna per la parità di opportunità e per creare un ambiente diversificato. Rispettiamo tutti gli individui e cerchiamo la loro inclusione nel luogo di lavoro.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Als Product-Spezialist für alternative Investments, die Private Assets (Private Equity, Private Debt, Immobilien) und diese niedrig liquiden Assets in Multi-Asset-Strategien integrieren, werden Sie mit der Verantwortung für Treuepflicht und Erklärungsverpflichtung die Geschäftsausweitung unterstützen.

Nutzen Sie Ihr Fachwissen im Finanzmarkt und Private Assets, um mit den globalen Investment- und Vertriebsabteilungen zusammenzuarbeiten, um neue Aufträge zu gewinnen und bestehende Aufträge zu verwalten. Darüber hinaus werden Sie mit internen Stakeholdern wie Produktentwicklung, Marketing und Back Office zusammenarbeiten, um auf Kundenanforderungen zugeschnittene Produktzusammensetzungen und Lösungen zu erstellen und Multi-Asset-Strategien zu entwickeln.

Hauptaufgaben:

• Vorschlag von Investmentlösungen für Kunden
• Erläuterung der zugewiesenen Produkte für Kunden und Geschäftsentwicklung (in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vertriebsabteilung)
• Planung und Entwicklung von Multi-Asset-Strategien, die niedrig liquide Assets wie Private Equity, Private Debt und Immobilien integrieren
• Überwachung des Betriebsstatus der zugewiesenen Produkte, Präsentation und Erläuterung während Betriebsberatungen und -berichten
• Beantwortung von RFPs und Kundenanfragen (in Zusammenarbeit mit dem RFP-Team)
• Überwachung von Strategie, Betriebsführung und Due Diligence für die zugewiesenen Produkte
• Sicherstellung der Produktqualität
• Andere verwandte Aufgaben

• Sie werden mit dem globalen Investment-Team, dem Product-Spezialist-Abteilung, anderen Abteilungen innerhalb des Product Management (Produktentwicklung, RFP, operative Datenanalyse), dem Vertriebsabteilung und anderen verwandten Abteilungen zusammenarbeiten.

Gewünschte und minimale Erfahrung:

• 5 Jahre oder mehr Erfahrung im Finanzsektor (Investmentgesellschaften, Brokerfirmen, etc.)
• Fachwissen und Erfahrung im Bereich Private Assets (Private Equity, Private Debt, Immobilien)

Sprachen:
• Englisch: Business-Level
• Japanisch: Muttersprachler

Hinweis:
Wir akzeptieren keine Lebensläufe über Agenturen.

Diversität und Inklusion:
Pictet ist ein gleichberechtigter Arbeitgeber und engagiert sich für eine diversifizierte Umgebung. Wir respektieren alle Individuen und suchen ihre Einbindung in den Arbeitsplatz.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
En tant que Spécialiste Produit pour les investissements alternatifs, incluant les actifs privés (Private Equity, Private Debt, Immobilier) et ces actifs à faible liquidité dans des stratégies Multi-Assets, vous assumerez la responsabilité fiduciaire et d'explication tout en contribuant à la croissance de l'entreprise.

En utilisant vos connaissances en marché financier et en actifs privés, vous collaborerez avec les départements mondiaux de gestion et de vente pour acquérir de nouveaux clients et gérer les existants. De plus, vous travaillerez avec les parties prenantes internes telles que le développement produit, le marketing et le back office pour créer des compositions de produits et des solutions sur mesure pour les clients, en développant des stratégies Multi-Assets.

Principales responsabilités:

• Proposer des solutions d'investissement aux clients
• Expliquer les produits attribués aux clients et participer aux activités de développement d'affaires (en collaboration avec le département de vente)
• Planifier et développer des stratégies Multi-Assets incluant des actifs à faible liquidité comme Private Equity, Private Debt et Immobilier
• Surveiller l'état opérationnel des produits attribués, présenter et expliquer lors de réunions et rapports opérationnels
• Répondre aux RFP et questions des clients (en collaboration avec l'équipe RFP)
• Surveiller la stratégie, l'opération et la diligence due pour les produits attribués
• Garantir la qualité des produits
• Autres tâches connexes

• Vous collaborerez avec l'équipe mondiale de gestion, le département Spécialistes Produit, d'autres départements au sein du Product Management (développement produit, RFP, analyse de données opérationnelles), le département de vente et d'autres départements connexes.

Expérience souhaitée et minimale:

• 5 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le secteur financier (sociétés de gestion, sociétés de courtage, etc.)
• Connaissances et expérience dans le domaine des actifs privés (Private Equity, Private Debt, Immobilier)

Langues:
• Anglais: Niveau business
• Japonais: Niveau natif

Note:
Nous n'accepterons aucun CV via des agences.

Diversité et Inclusion:
Pictet est un employeur égalitaire et s'engage pour un environnement diversifié. Nous respectons tous les individus et recherchons leur inclusion dans le lieu de travail.
